verdict: M200 is a correct and synthesizable standalone raw4-to-descriptor2 stable compactor at the sealed RTL SHA. The first descriptor-stall defect is repaired sufficiently for this conservative interface because every visible output stall now freezes raw ingress; sealed and independent VCS show stable payload and exact conservation. The 1.099079848 throughput/area number remains an additive screen, not an integrated or physical speedup.

attacks: descriptor payload stability under multi-cycle output stall
raw payload stability while backpressured by a stalled descriptor
release into same-cycle raw push and descriptor pop
window close in raw lane one and lane three
all-zero token and mixed zero/nonzero raw groups
one-, two-, and three-lane final raw residual packets
depth-two, depth-four, and depth-eight compact windows
reset while a descriptor is pending and stalled, followed by a clean token
malformed non-prefix lanes and wrong raw_last fail-closed attacks

first_stall_bug_audit.exploratory_failure_signature: 22 ap_hold_descriptor_on_stall failures caused by descriptor view mutation under output stall
first_stall_bug_audit.repair_mechanism: raw_ready is forced low whenever descriptor_valid is high and descriptor_ready is low, so neither queue append nor pop can mutate the visible descriptor during a stall
first_stall_bug_audit.sealed_repair_result: zero assertion failures with 324 sealed output-stall cycles
first_stall_bug_audit.independent_repair_result: 493 output-stall cycles and 331 cycles with raw held behind that stall, with stable interfaces and zero drop/duplicate/reorder
first_stall_bug_audit.assessment: sufficient for the standalone conservative contract; it sacrifices ingress decoupling during every output stall and is not evidence for integrated result-backpressure throughput

independent_dc_replay.hold_assessment: formally MET in this ideal-clock pre-macro DC model, but 0.0007 ns is only 0.7 ps and is not a robust physical hold margin

additive_proxy_recompute.assessment: positive 9.9079848 percent logic-only screen, but the speed numerator comes from M199 abstract replay rather than M200 RTL replay

matched_s4_f4_decision.priority: P0 before choosing F2 as the paper hardware point
matched_s4_f4_decision.reason: M199 shows S4/F2 retains 97.5748684 percent of S4/F4 abstract throughput, but M200 spends 873 sequential cells on an eight-entry reservoir. A matched F4 may use a shallower reservoir and simpler queue movement, so doubling the output bus does not imply higher total logic area or energy and may invalidate the F2 selection.
required_match: same raw4 input contract, zero filter, token/window rules and fail-closed backpressure
same reset, stall, partial, zero, residual-lane, order/drop/duplicate VCS attacks
same TSMC28 libraries, 3 ns constraints, ideal clock and ZeroWireload
report area, sequential bits, logic levels, setup and hold, plus replayed accepted-raw and emitted-descriptor cycles
compare F2 and F4 with identical queue/bypass assumptions rather than output width alone

findings.finding: Sealed hashes and manifests are internally consistent; exact-SHA VCS and DC evidence are reproducible.

An independently authored VCS scoreboard covers reset, stalls, simultaneous push/pop, mid-lane boundaries, zero elision, partial raw tails and exact order/conservation with 3,424 descriptors and no discrepancy.
Independent 3 ns DC exactly reproduces 4,808.286021 um2, 6,296 cells, 873 sequential cells, 31 levels and 1.0599 ns setup slack.

M200 does not implement the M199 same-cycle fresh-candidate emit/bypass recurrence: descriptor outputs view only the registered queue. Therefore the abstract 1.241353012x numerator has not been cycle-matched to this RTL under finite tokens/backpressure.
Run matched S4/F4 VCS/DC before locking S4/F2. The F2 queue/storage and shift network may cost more than the extra F4 output width; output-bit ratio is not an area or energy result.
Complete-FC2 admission still needs composition with accepted window-head advancement, tagged SRAM response/stale quarantine, Acc24, odd-tail release and commit under backpressure.
The 0.7 ps pre-macro hold slack passes the written zero threshold but offers negligible physical margin; retain physical_speedup=false and rerun post-route/CTS hold before any PPA claim.
Run RTL-to-gate Formality for the compactor if it is retained; current SVF/mapped netlist exist, but no equivalence receipt is admitted.
